description: This file defines a test double (spy) class for the CalendarSyncOrchestrator used in unit testing. It tracks calendar sync operations, simulates success or failure, and provides methods for verification of sync behavior without performing real external calendar operations.

classes.name: FakeCalendarSyncOrchestrator
classes.description: A spy implementation of CalendarSyncOrchestrator that records sync calls, simulates success/failure, and provides methods to verify interactions during testing.

methods.name: setShouldSucceed
methods.description: Sets whether the orchestrator should simulate successful operations or failures.

methods.name: syncAllCalendarAccounts
methods.description: Simulates syncing all calendar accounts; records the call and can throw an exception if configured to fail.

methods.name: syncCalendarAccount
methods.description: Simulates syncing a specific calendar account; records the account info, and throws on failure.

methods.name: syncEvent
methods.description: Simulates syncing a calendar event; records the operation details, can return false to simulate failure.

methods.name: getSyncedOperations
methods.description: Returns all recorded sync event operations.

methods.name: getSyncedAccounts
methods.description: Returns all recorded sync account operations.

methods.name: wasSyncCalled
methods.description: Checks if any sync operation (event or account) was called.

methods.name: wasSyncEventCalled
methods.description: Checks if any event sync was called.

methods.name: wasSyncAccountCalled
methods.description: Checks if any account sync was called.

methods.name: getLastOperation
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent sync event operation.

methods.name: getLastAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent account sync operation.

methods.name: getOperationCount
methods.description: Returns the number of sync event operations recorded.

methods.name: getAccountSyncCount
methods.description: Returns the number of account sync operations recorded.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets all recorded data and defaults to simulate success.
